purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Mosop Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 150 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This is a 4-page landscape-table form with an unusually dense 8-numeric-column layout; page 1 (form sub-page 05/12) carries the column headers, which for this constituency's printed form are in the non-standard order Voters per Polling Station, DAVID WAIHIGA MWAURE, GEORGE WAJACKOYAH, RAILA ODINGA, WILLIAM SAMOEI RUTO, Votes Cast, Rejected Votes, Valid Votes -- confirmed by reading the header page before assigning any TOTAL-row digit to a field, since assuming the standard Odinga/Ruto/Waihiga/Wajackoyah order used on most other constituencies' forms would have misattributed every candidate cell here. 'Votes Cast' and 'Valid Votes' print the identical figure on every row (verified against several individual polling-station rows), i.e. Votes Cast is a redundant repeat of Valid Votes rather than a distinct ballots-cast total, so total_valid_votes is read from either of those two identical columns. Page 3 (form sub-page 07/12) carries the final TOTAL row; the PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt), so all values were read visually from the rendered page image and independently cross-confirmed with a separate 500 DPI crop of the TOTAL row. The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (auto-located by green-shading pixel detection, scripts/p23/find_total_row.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
